# Blockchains

> GitHub profile README for Ismail Malik / Blockchain Lab: live sites, the open-source toolkit and pointers to Build with Blocks.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/Blockchains/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/Blockchains/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/Blockchains/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [README.md](https://github.com/Blockchains/Blockchains/blob/main/README.md): profile
